name: MP3Quran API (v3)
description: The world's leading high-bandwidth Islamic audio CDN and REST API. Provides full MP3 audio recitations for over 250+ world-renowned Qurra (reciters), multiple Riwayat (Hafs, Warsh, Qalun, Al-Duri), 114 Surahs, live 24/7 Quran radio stations, Tafsir audio lectures, and Holy Sanctuary live video feeds (Makkah & Madinah).

rateLimit.policy: Open access. High performance CDN edge caching.

endpoints.name: List All Reciters
endpoints.description: Lists reciters with localized names, available Moshafs (Riwayat), audio server base URLs, and list of available surah audio numbers.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Language code (ar, eng, fr, ru, etc.)

endpoints.name: List All Suwar (Surahs)
endpoints.description: Returns list of 114 Surahs with revelation place (Makki/Madani), starting page, and localized name.

endpoints.name: List Riwayat (Moshafs)
endpoints.description: Lists all Quranic narrations / recitation styles (e.g., Hafs 'an Asim, Warsh 'an Nafi', Qalun).

endpoints.name: Live Quran Radio Stations
endpoints.description: Returns 150+ live streaming 24/7 internet radio URLs for specific reciters, translations, and Islamic topics.

endpoints.name: Audio Tafasir (Commentaries)
endpoints.description: Returns audio tafsir lessons and explanations indexed by Surah.

endpoints.name: Live Holy Sanctuaries TV
endpoints.description: Returns official 24/7 live video stream URLs for Makkah (Masjid al-Haram) and Madinah (Al-Masjid an-Nabawi).

endpoints.name: Available Languages
endpoints.description: Returns list of all supported languages across the API with localization links.

audioUrlFormat.description: Reciter audio files are constructed using reciter.moshaf[i].server + 3-digit padded surah number + .mp3
